Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. We once discussed veterinary medicine from the perspective of how humans came to the idea of helping other living creatures while spending their own time and resources on it. Strictly speaking, this mostly applies to pets, because in the industrial world veterinarians often work with farm animals. Today I want you to think about how incredibly complex this science really is. A veterinarian has to understand the anatomy and physiology of dozens of different species in order to help them.
